name: Benz's Sugar Shanty & Maple Products
description: Benz's Sugar Shanty & Maple Products is an agritourism farm in 939 Van Slyke Road, NY, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
